group_rule: Compare original stored Day-60 target with latest observed original Day 0-30 score, before float32 conversion; exact equality, no tuned threshold.
weight_rule: N/(K*n_group), K is the number of nonempty training groups. Full requires all three; smoke may omit groups. Mean training weight is one.
loss: mean(weight * absolute_error) per batch; no batch weight renormalization or resampling
selection: Unchanged GV01: earliest strictly lowest unweighted validation MAE from epoch 1, patience 15 in full.
